scope: Source-conditioned information retrieval and qualified claim verification; not airworthiness or diagnostic decision validation
test_policy: All other declared document families; revisions, translations and query variants remain grouped. Corpus is shared at retrieval time; development and test information needs are separated.
annotation: AI authored and independently source reconstructed by another agent, followed by reconciliation; no human aviation expert annotation
unit_of_analysis: Distinct query fact_id; translation/scenario pairs are stress tests, not independent facts. Graph polarity variants share claim_group_id; claims within source families remain dependent.
evidence: UTF-8 NFC/LF canonical text offsets in Unicode code points, end exclusive; document hash and individual span hash; all/any evidence semantics; no chunk identifiers in ground truth
relevance: Selected exact evidence supports are not exhaustive passage qrels. Unjudged passages must not be silently scored irrelevant. Report strict evidence coverage and declared source hit separately; build and adjudicate alternative evidence pools before publication-grade nDCG/MRR claims.
answerability: Insufficient evidence means unavailable within this frozen corpus for the specified scope, not false in the real world. Review searches are recorded.
graph_task: Qualified claim verification over selected claims; not exhaustive extraction gold. Extraction recall requires full predicate-restricted annotation of selected passages.
statistics: Use paired fact-level differences and document-family connected-component bootstrap, not query-level IID bootstrap. Show effect size and uncertainty. Small family counts restrict generalization. Retrieval repeats on a deterministic index are timing measurements, not independent experiments.
ablation: Same frozen corpus, queries, filters and evidence labels; one variable at a time. Fixed/structure/hierarchical chunking crossed with BM25/real dense/hybrid RRF; reranking separately. Equal context token budgets plus latency and memory. Do not tune on test.
model_policy: Offline token-vector or hashing baselines must be identified as lexical; they cannot substantiate semantic dense or hybrid benefits. Log model revision, tokenizer, dimensionality, settings and seed for real dense/reranker runs.
publication_gates: all evidence hashes match frozen sources
alternative qrels reviewed for rank metrics
human domain spot review required before calling expert gold
no current maintenance applicability claim from historical sources

graph_stress_amendment.reason: Independent audit found all five native negative claims supported. Add six independently source-reconstructed negative contradicted pairs as a separate negation stress stratum; do not inflate independent claim groups.

all_any_scope: All 126 current queries require all declared spans; any semantics are tool support only and have no evaluated samples.
shared_concept_disclosure: FAA AC development facts recur in CAAC test source text. Current target information needs do not duplicate these development targets; corpus and concepts are not claimed wholly unseen.
